verdict.overall: The biggest mover since Sunday is PLTR, down almost 5% with its support floor collapsing toward 150, making it the weakest setup, while APP (+7.5%) and ZETA (turning supportive) look firmer but are both near earnings dates. TSLA, AVGO, GOOGL and the SPY/QQQ trackers show the steadiest, most range-bound setups for swing trades, though most options chains remain pricey and NVDA's Nov 17 earnings sit inside the 4-week window. Confidence in the calmer names (SPY, QQQ, AVGO) is steady, while confidence in PLTR and APP is weakening given the sharp recent swings.
